data.name: Hayyan
data.gender_notes: Hayyan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hayat' which means life, Hayyan signifies someone who is alive or living. The name Hayyan carries the meaning “Alive, Living” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hayyan usually hope their child will grow to embody alive, living and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Hayyan is associated with the Arabic term 'hayat' which signifies life. It is believed that those bearing this name will lead a fulfilling and meaningful life.
data.etymology: Hayyan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Alive, Living.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hayyan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
